textData.text: Matrix Massage & Bodywork: Your Local Wellness Destination in Salem, WI
Welcome to
Matrix Massage & Bodywork
in Salem, Wisconsin, serving Pleasant Prairie, Bristol, Antioch and Paddock Lake. Explore massage and wellness options for relaxation, bodywork and time devoted to your comfort.
Whether you’re an athlete recovering from muscle strain, someone
navigating chronic pain
, or just in need of serious self-care, Matrix is your sanctuary. Here’s a full breakdown of what we offer — and why your body and mind will thank you.
🔥 Signature Massage Services
Deep Tissue Massage
Target stubborn knots and chronic tension with our results-driven deep tissue massage. Ideal for athletes, desk workers, and anyone carrying stress in their neck, shoulders, or back.
Benefits:
Focuses on areas of muscle soreness and tension
Pressure and positioning adapted to your comfort
A session planned around your bodywork goals
💬 Client Favorite: Pair it with muscle scraping and red light therapy in our Muscle Recovery Package.
Swedish & Relaxation Massage
Our Swedish massage offers an unhurried session with pressure and techniques tailored to your preferences. Choose it when you want time to unwind and attention to everyday muscle tension.
Benefits:
Time for relaxation and a pause from daily stress
A quiet setting to slow down
Gentle bodywork adapted to your comfort
💆 Try it with aromatherapy and a magnesium foot scrub for ultimate relaxation.
Lymphatic Drainage Massage

Manual lymphatic drainage uses specialized light techniques. Suitability depends on your needs; post-procedure care requires guidance from your treating clinician. It is not a universal detox or immune-boost service.
Benefits:
Discuss swelling-related goals after appropriate assessment
Individual planning rather than a generic detox schedule
Post-procedure treatment only when appropriate and cleared
🌹 Included in our Cellular Regeneration Package with red light therapy and cupping.
Explore Our Wellness Packages
1. Rejuvenation Package – For stress relief and full-body reset
Includes Swedish or lymphatic massage, facial with light lymphatic drainage, aromatherapy (lavender, chamomile, frankincense), red light therapy, and hydrogen water.
2. Cellular Regeneration Package– For skin, tissue, and detox support
Includes lymphatic massage, red light therapy, cupping (optional), and aromatherapy (rose, geranium, sandalwood).
3. Muscle Recovery Package –For athletes and chronic pain clients
Includes deep tissue or sports massage, cupping, muscle scraping, peppermint/eucalyptus/ginger oils, and hydrogen water.
4. Muscle Repair & Energizing Package- For fatigue and circulation boost
Swedish or deep tissue massage with red light therapy, muscle scraping, citrus/rosemary/black pepper oils, and hydrogen water.
💡 Why Choose
Red Light Therapy?
Ask about the red light equipment and session instructions used for your visit.
About Red Light Sessions:
Light-based wellness sessions with device-specific instructions
Research findings depend on the equipment, dose and outcome studied
Discuss your goals and relevant precautions before a session
Wellness care does not replace medical treatment or hormone management
🧠 It’s a client-favorite add-on — or book as part of your membership package for even more savings.
🌿 Magnesium Soaks, Scrubs & Balms — Made In-House

Ask about our current magnesium soaks, scrubs and body-care products. Choose a product for its feel, ingredients and place in your relaxation routine; topical use should not be treated as a way to correct magnesium deficiency.
⭐ Client Favorites:
Lavender + Chamomile Magnesium Soak – for an unhurried soaking ritual
Mint + Citrus Magnesium Scrub – for a refreshing body-care routine
Muscle Balm – ask about ingredients and intended cosmetic use
🛁 Available for purchase in the studio or as part of your recovery session.
